_note: The customer survey's questions, shared by the /survey page and the printed survey card (src/studio/survey-card.njk), so the two always ask the same thing. Keep it short: every question added is a customer who stops halfway. `ratings` are tap-one-of-four on the page and circle-one on paper; `choices` are pick-one; `open` are free text. `name` is the field name in the email Formspree sends.
